method: Independently inspected actual original032, all eight revision08b render PNGs, and revision08 stowed-hero. Scoped visual comparison, not registered image similarity or engineering acceptance.
improvements: Broad separate reverse armor now extends to the center waist; revision08 exposed-gray-casting regression is repaired in stowed and intermediate views.
Front stepped casings, paired mounting plates and segmented hub detail remain visible.
Added true deployed-back view exposes rear construction for candid assessment.

remainingDefects.finding: The broad reverse plates fix coverage but remain plain. Reference032 shows shaped rear framing, dense layered hardware, two detailed buckle straps and cable-like runs; the model has a broad plain center, circular back disk and simplified strap blocks. The stowed casing lacks the reference elongated orange feature and compact mechanical segmentation.

Hub remains relatively small and uniformly concentric; rear silhouette, layered transitions and source-specific mechanical construction remain simplified. No dimensional contradiction in source should be concealed by changing the fixed 95 cm height or treating 25 cm as collapsed height.

Visible finish is clean, evenly gray and orange accents appear salmon under these controls. Reference has darker gunmetal, saturated safety orange, localized chipped edges and stronger part-specific wear. Fine roughness speckle does not yet match that character.

True deployed-back view is now supplied, but no true orthographic side or wearer-fit motion evidence. Normal-to-face carriage extension remains a proposed mechanism with unresolved wearer clearance/fit.

limits: No visual acceptance, GPU appearance, Unreal import, structural or gameplay certification.
Separate actual Blender/Godot/Three CPU import and animation-bound evidence is in shield08b-* import-check reports.
Author-reported 721 sampled surface clearance states are not independently rerun by this review.
